dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Lions Host Buccaneers in Week 11 as Cade Mays Lands on IR
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Detroit (7-2) enters Sunday's matchup against Tampa Bay (3-6) balancing interior offensive line adjustments with defensive health realities. Head coach Dan Campbell's team aims to protect its NFC North standing while facing an active Baker Mayfield.
bullets: Detroit placed center Cade Mays on injured reserve with an ankle issue, thrusting Juice Scruggs into the starting pivot, while signing cornerback Nick Whiteside and elevating linebacker Owen Pappoe, per [Justin Rogers](https://bsky.app/profile/detroitfootball.net/post/3n2u3yv5bku24) and [Detroit Lions Official](https://www.detroitlions.com/team/transactions/#tx-3b82b2c77f40).

Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is active despite thumb and foot injuries, while Detroit returns safety Kerby Joseph to anchor coverage shells against Tampa Bay, per [RotoWire NFL Beat](https://www.rotowire.com/football/player/baker-mayfield-12619) and [detroitlions.com Official](https://www.detroitlions.com/news/inactives-lions-vs-buccaneers-joseph-reed-rakestraw).

The league office reviewed Aidan Hutchinson's recent tackle on Drake Maye, ruling the technique was not an illegal hip-drop tackle and issuing no fine, according to [Justin Rogers](https://bsky.app/profile/detroitfootball.net/post/3n2u4hdczxa2n).

Defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard plans to leverage rookie edge Derrick Moore's growing rotational impact alongside interior tackle Alim McNeill against the Buccaneers' offense, as detailed by [detroitlions.com Official](https://www.detroitlions.com/news/moore-building-confidence-and-slowing-down-the-game-mcneill-wonnum).
